description: AI Secretary observable states for JuanProperty real estate, land portfolio, ownership, and agent tracking.

observable_states.semantic_meaning: A land parcel or property project is missing critical title deeds (TCT/OCT), tax declarations, or lot plans.
observable_states.suggested_task: Prompt property manager to upload and verify land title documents for [property_name].

observable_states.semantic_meaning: A registered land parcel has no GPS coordinates or boundary polygon defined for mapping.
observable_states.suggested_task: Add GPS coordinates (latitude/longitude) or boundary points for land parcel [property_name].

observable_states.semantic_meaning: A property listing or land project has no designated agent or broker assigned for client inquiries.
observable_states.suggested_task: Assign a licensed agent with phone and email contact details to [property_name].

observable_states.semantic_meaning: Philippine BIR withholding tax (Form 1601-EQ) or local Real Property Tax (RPT) due date approaching.
observable_states.suggested_task: Review tax computations and file BIR Form 1601-EQ / RPT payment for [property_name].
